## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:data` pass
- [ ] Follows the rules in AGENTS.md (no scraping, zero cost, privacy, sources cited, money in minor units)
- [ ] New dependency or data source? Added to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or commands changed
- [ ] Learned something non-obvious? Added an entry to LESSONS.md
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
